data.one_liner: A completionist set of lint rules aligned with Dart SDK versions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of Dart analysis options with most rules enabled. It follows Dart SDK versions to maintain parity with rules available in the stable channel.
use_when: You want a completionist set of lint rules for your Dart or Flutter project
You want your analysis options to stay aligned with Dart SDK versions
avoid_when: You prefer minimal or very relaxed lint rules
Your project's Flutter version does not ship a compatible stable Dart version for the latest rules
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Dart linter rules
Maintains parity with stable channel Dart SDK linter rules
weaknesses: Requires managing version alignment with the Dart SDK
May require project customization and disabling rules to fit specific codebases
data.setup_notes: Add tidy to dev_dependencies and include package:tidy/analysis_options.yaml in your analysis_options.yaml file.
